**Tier 4** — decisions — policies, overrides, scenarios · owned by `platform` · `public.external_evidence`

**One row is** One retrieved external claim about a supply chain, as a subject–predicate–object triple with the source it came from, the confidence attached to it and the hash of the content it was read from. The network cartographer's evidence store: what an agent FOUND, kept apart from what a person entered.

## Uniqueness

| Columns | Source | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | column PRIMARY KEY | `external_evidence_pkey` |
| `project_id` + `source_id` + `content_hash` + `md5(triple::text)` | UNIQUE index | `external_evidence_dedupe_uq` |

## Constraints

These reject the row outright. A value that fails one of them does not arrive
partially or get corrected — the write fails.

| Constraint | Rule | Added by |
|---|---|---|
| `external_evidence_source_id_check` | `CHECK (char_length(source_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)` | `20260727000001_network_cartographer.sql` |
| `external_evidence_content_hash_check` | `CHECK (char_length(content_hash) BETWEEN 8 AND 128)` | `20260727000001_network_cartographer.sql` |
| `external_evidence_confidence_check` | `CHECK (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)` | `20260727000001_network_cartographer.sql` |
| `external_evidence_lei_check` | `CHECK (lei IS NULL OR lei ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{20}$')` | `20260727000001_network_cartographer.sql` |

## Governance

| | |
|---|---|
| Read capability | any project member |
| Write capability | **no user-facing write path** |
| Minimum project role | `editor` |
| Tier transitions audited | yes |
| Row-level security | enabled |
| Policies on the table | 1 — **1 with no predicate** |

Tier 4 — the DECISION plane: what a person or an agent CHOSE, as against the dataset they chose it over and the result it produced. `result-binding` (I8) needs all three, which is why WP 6.3 keeps the results and this package takes the decisions. Audited from WP 6.4: the three statement-grain triggers land beside this sidecar, because `dataPlaneAudit.test.ts` scopes its rule to tables IN the contract and a deferred table's writes are unaudited with nothing to notice (D54). **Its writers are edge functions, not the browser** — `project-ai- chat`'s cartographer and sentinel tools — so the audit trigger names whoever the function's transaction has set, and an agent write with no actor is the D28 question this table inherits rather than answers. The dedupe index is what makes a re-read of the same page a no-op instead of a second claim.

> **What the database actually permits is wider than the row above.**
> 1 policy here grants access with
> **no predicate at all** (`USING (true)`), so the capability named above is what the
> product intends to check, not what the database enforces:
>
> - `external_evidence_read_all` — `SELECT` to `anon`, `authenticated`
>
> See PLAN.md D28: the application runs as the
> `anon` role with no auth session and the anon key ships in the frontend bundle, so
> closing these is a migration with an auth model behind it rather than a policy edit.

## Columns

`CSV header` is the name the **user types**, which is not always the column name —
that gap is defect D21. A dash means the column has no CSV origin.

| Column | CSV header | Type | Unit | Required in CSV | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` 🔑 | — | `uuid` | — | — | Surrogate key. The dedupe key is the four-column unique index below. |
| `project_id` | — | `uuid` | — | — | The project the claim is about. |
| `source_id` | — | `text` | — | — | Which source produced it — a registry, a filing, a page. CHECK-constrained, so a claim cannot arrive from a source the system does not name. |
| `url_or_ref` | — | `text` | — | — | Where a person can go and look. NULL where the source has no addressable reference, which is a real state for a registry lookup and not a missing value. |
| `content_hash` | — | `text` | — | — | The hash of the content the claim was read from. Part of the dedupe key, so the same bytes re-read produce no second row — and a CHANGED page produces a new claim rather than overwriting the old one. |
| `retrieved_at` | — | `timestamp with time zone` | — | — | When it was fetched. The claim is about the world at that moment, and nothing refreshes it. |
| `confidence` | — | `numeric` | — | — | How much weight the extractor put on this claim, CHECK-constrained to its range. It is the EXTRACTOR's number, not a person's, and no surface today turns it into a decision. |
| `triple` | — | `jsonb` | — | — | THE CLAIM — subject, predicate, object as JSON. Hashed into the dedupe key through `md5(triple::text)`, which is why an expression index appears in the natural key above. |
| `lei` | — | `text` | — | — | The Legal Entity Identifier the claim is about, where one resolved. CHECK-constrained to the LEI shape, and NULL where the subject is not a registered entity — a great many suppliers are not. |
